create_distribution_wishart: create a Wishart distribution with degrees of freedom and a covariance matrix for Bayesian covariance estimation
sample_wishart_matrix: sample a Wishart-distributed positive-definite matrix using Bartlett decomposition with singular sample correction
compute_wishart_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a Wishart distribution parameterized by df and scale_tril
compute_wishart_entropy: compute the differential entropy of a Wishart distribution given its degrees of freedom and covariance matrix
expand_wishart_batch: expand a Wishart distribution to a larger batch shape while preserving event shape and parameters
